title: Fine Tuning Your Medical Report Classifier: Data to Adapter

sections.label: 1 - PREPARE THE TRAINING DATA
sections.note: Your CSV in, a clean labeled dataset out. Duplicates and unusable rows removed, suspect labels returned to you, then a stratified validation and test split held out before any training so the eval is honest.

sections.label: 2 - SELECT THE MODEL AND TRAINING FORMAT
sections.note: An existing lightweight open source model, not trained from scratch. Classifier head on a small encoder if you only need the label, LoRA on a small instruct model if you also want a written reason. Rows converted to that model's fine tuning format.

sections.label: 3 - BASELINE, FINE TUNE, ITERATE
sections.note: The untouched model is scored on the held out set first, so the before number is measured. Then a LoRA adapter is trained for a few epochs on your hardware or cloud, evaluated per category, and the loop repeats until it beats the baseline where it matters.

sections.label: 4 - DELIVERABLES YOU CAN REUSE
sections.note: Adapter files, an inference script for new reports, the full training and inference code with setup instructions, and a short summary of dataset, model, approach, results, and limitations.
